summary: The school emphasizes the importance of E-Rate funding for providing affordable Internet and hardware upgrades, which are critical for maintaining educational opportunities. The school argues that loss of E-Rate funding would have a significant impact on student educational opportunities.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, schools would not be able to afford necessary Internet upgrades
claims.evidence_quote: Our school has relied on E-rate funding since it began in 1998. It has been instrumental in providing affordable Internet (and phone years ago) and hardware upgrades. We typically are in the 40-50% discount category. Without these funds we would not be able to afford necessary WiFi upgrades about once every 5 years.
